description: This file defines the WorkspaceService class for managing workspaces, including CRUD operations, validation, sharing, and related entity management within a project using TypeORM and related entities.

classes.name: WorkspaceService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for managing workspaces, including creation, reading, updating, deletion, sharing, and validation within a database context.

methods.name: validateWorkspaceId
methods.description: Validates if the provided workspace ID is a valid UUID.

methods.name: readWorkspaceById
methods.description: Fetches a workspace by its ID using a query runner.

methods.name: validateWorkspaceName
methods.description: Validates the workspace name, ensuring it is valid and not a reserved name unless during registration.

methods.name: readWorkspaceByOrganizationId
methods.description: Retrieves workspaces associated with an organization, filtering out personal workspaces.

methods.name: createNewWorkspace
methods.description: Creates a new workspace object with generated ID and validated name.

methods.name: saveWorkspace
methods.description: Persists a workspace entity to the database.

methods.name: createWorkspace
methods.description: Creates and saves a new workspace within a transaction, validating organization and user existence.

methods.name: updateWorkspace
methods.description: Updates an existing workspace's data, validating and merging changes.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceById
methods.description: Deletes a workspace and all related entities in proper order to maintain referential integrity.

methods.name: getSharedWorkspacesForItem
methods.description: Retrieves workspaces sharing a specific item.

methods.name: getSharedItemsForWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves shared items of a specific type within a workspace.

methods.name: setSharedWorkspacesForItem
methods.description: Sets shared workspaces for a specific item, replacing existing shares.

methods.name: setNullWorkspaceId
methods.description: Updates all entities with null workspaceId to a specified workspaceId, used for data migration.
